items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him he will be inactive Sunday vs DET while details are completed. Houston among teams with interest; no deal until after Sunday games.
items.why: Trade being finalized; team informed him Saturday morning.
items.implication: Zero fantasy production this week; long-term destination TBD (HOU possible reunion with Stroud).
items.opportunity: Opens targets/routes for remaining ARI pass-catchers.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT (hamstring) for Eagles vs JAX in London.
items.why: Hamstring; DNP all week, official final designation.
items.implication: No production; Eagles backfield and pass game thinned.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining RBs; more targets to Wicks/Goedert if active.

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT (ankle) for Ravens vs ATL.
items.why: Ankle injury; DNP all week, confirmed out.
items.implication: Huntley starts; reduced rushing upside and overall offense ceiling.
items.opportunity: Likely/Andrews/Flowers (if active) target share up in non-Lamar offense.

items.text: Stefon Diggs listed OUT (hamstring) for Commanders.
items.implication: No production; WAS WR depth tested with McLaurin also Q.
items.opportunity: More targets to McLaurin (if plays), Deebo, or TE/checkdowns with Daniels back.

items.text: DeVonta Smith listed OUT (hamstring) alongside Barkley/Hollywood Brown for Eagles.
items.why: Hamstring; full week DNP, ruled out.
items.implication: Eagles pass game depleted in London.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Dontayvion Wicks and remaining WRs/TE.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: Foot and ankle; elevation signals contingency.
items.implication: Game-time or limited risk; monitor Sunday.
items.opportunity: If OUT/limited, Hemby or committee mates absorb carries.

items.text: MHJ had only 5 catches in 4 games and was not a real factor even in Michael Wilson target spikes; inactive/trade means Kia Kendrick Bourne season.
items.why: Production data shows limited involvement; Wilson already eating.
items.implication: Wilson/McBride/Bourne absorb leftover; MHJ absence low incremental hit to ARI offense volume.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson target ceiling rises further vs DET.

items.text: Breece Hall listed OUT (quad) for Jets.
Quentin Johnston OUT; Michael Pittman OUT (later confirmed IR by Schefter, min 4 games).
items.why: Johnston chest; Pittman foot to IR.
items.implication: LAC and PIT WR rooms thinned; Pittman multi-week absence.
items.opportunity: Ladd McConkey (Q) or others up in LAC; PIT WR2/3 elevated.

items.text: IN: Jeremiyah Love, Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert (among others). Love not on final report.
items.why: Cleared final report or expected; Daniels return from elbow.
items.implication: Full or near-full roles restored; Love workload key.
items.opportunity: Love projected larger role; Daniels elevates WAS offense; Olave/Goedert reliable.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love tough projection but expected much better role than Week 4 usage (dragged by fans/media); not on final IR, ankle maintenance only. ETR has him 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier currently.
items.why: Public/media pressure on prior usage + cleared report; gut says better role despite long-year downside risk.
items.implication: Strong RB start/sit lean; clear lead over committee mate in projs.
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry/route share expected vs DET.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle flares or coaches split more.

items.text: Week 5 Loves: Nico Collins WR8 @TEN (volume/RZ + matchup), Michael Wilson WR10 vs DET, Christian Watson WR15 vs CHI, Isaiah Likely TE5 @WSH, Chase Brown RB5 @MIA (targets + nickname push).
items.why: Target-hog volume, red-zone work, and soft defensive matchups; Brown gobbles targets/points.
items.implication: Strong start recommendations; Wilson boosted further by MHJ inactive.
items.opportunity: High route/target/RZ shares in favorable spots.

items.text: Nabers multi-risk stack long-term: knee (missed practice), lingering shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB change, and boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) could go sideways despite greatness. Short-term still good but monitor.
items.why: Sore knee + frustration over second-half targets + stacked injury/QB/coach risks.
items.implication: Hold but hedge ROS; not pure set-and-forget.
items.opportunity: Still high-upside if healthy and scheme stays aggressive.
items.conflict: Usage still elite when on field.

items.text: Week 5 Hates: Jordan Addison WR41 @NO (injury wrinkle + role), Mark Andrews TE17 @ATL, Cam Skattebo RB20 @WSH, Tony Pollard RB28 vs HOU, Jalen Hurts QB15 vs JAX (rough stretch + OL). Also nervous on Tyler Shough.
items.why: Tough matchups, thin/inefficient roles, usage data, game environment, and injury concerns.
items.implication: Fade/sit leans; pivot to loves or safer options.
